questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Conservation must consider connected habitats and local conditions.
options: Conservation must consider connected habitats and local conditions.
Protecting one isolated patch always protects every species.
Roads cannot affect the movement of wildlife.
Every river should be managed in exactly the same way.
questions.explanation: Metnin genel sonucu: Conservation must consider connected habitats and local conditions.
